name: tamulib-dc-labs/archipelago-twig-render
description: Renders Archipelago metadata display templates against fixtures and validates the output

note: This tier answers a different question from tools/twig-lint. That one asks whether
Archipelago would ACCEPT a template (parse time). This one asks whether the template
PRODUCES VALID OUTPUT when fed known metadata -- the failure that breaks viewers.
A template emitting {"items":[{...},]} parses perfectly and saves into Archipelago
without complaint. Only rendering it and parsing the result catches that.
